about: The lee along Lake Silvaplana's south-east shore, measured on the satellite photos by tools/map/shore_lee.py: don't edit. Layer 1: the lee's shape (its share of the band's lee, 1 = the band 50 to 250 m from the shore on average). Layer 2: the share of the wind the game's fixed pattern (W1) already takes off there (the photos' average lee).
format: two float32 little-endian layers, each row by row from the north edge, each row from west to east
